text.enUS: Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler. At Dreadmist Peak, druids seek tainted water in an empty Cenarion vessel. The sample may help diagnose and cure the blight spreading among wildlife in the northern Barrens. Dendrite Starblaze suspects the pools atop Dreadmist Peak are at the heart of a sickness afflicting gazelles and unsettling the northern Barrens. The pools influence the weather, and the druid fears they are tied to the spreading blight. He sends druid initiates with empty samplers to brave the mountain heights and draw water from the peak. The Burning Blade, a demon-worshipping cult, now infests the mountain.

Empty Leaden Collection Phial. The Empty Leaden Collection Phial is a shielded container designed by gnome tinkerers to harvest radioactive fallout from the ruins of Gnomeregan. Crafted from lead to protect the bearer from lethal contamination, it is used by adventurers assisting Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. Ozzie hopes the captured glow might yield a cure for their afflicted kin—or at least an extraordinarily potent beverage. When the vents of Gnomeregan flooded the subterranean city with toxic radiation to purge the trogg menace, it instead warped the surviving defenders into leper gnomes and irradiated the invading beasts. Seeking to study and reverse the fallout, Ozzie Togglevolt crafted the Empty Leaden Collection Phial. Made of heavy lead to shield handlers from the ambient danger, the specialized vial draws in the noxious green glow lingering on the bodies of Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers that prowl the ruins. Once sealed, the resulting Full Leaden Collection Phial provides the raw, dangerous matter needed for experimental remedies.

Empty Red Waterskin. In Tarren Mill, an empty red waterskin is bound for a well untouched by blight. Brine gives it to shaman initiates for their elemental trials. Brine gives shaman initiates this plain red skin for the Call of Water trials. They carry it across the sea to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken occupy the town, but its central well still draws fresh spring water. The filled skin brings a sample to Brine, who blends the water into a vial of purest water for the initiate’s trial.

Empty Sampling Tube. Thundris Windweaver gives an Empty Sampling Tube in Auberdine to gather water from the Cliffspring River. Night elf scholars study the taint threatening Darkshore. Darkshore's waterways are turning foul as blight spreads through the wilderness. Thundris Windweaver, an investigator in Auberdine, gives you an empty glass tube to collect water from the Cliffspring River. Take the sample from the pool beneath the first waterfall north of town. Night elf naturalists examine it to learn about the corruption flowing toward Mist's Edge.

Empty Water Tube. In Auberdine, the Empty Water Tube is ready to gather sacred moonwell water for the red crystal on Darkshore’s eastern cliffs. Sentinels and scholars seek pure lunar essence to study the mysterious red crystal along Darkshore’s eastern ridge. Ordinary glass or flasks can contaminate consecrated water, so investigators visiting Auberdine’s moonwell receive this sealed vial for the work. They carry its filled contents up the mountain slopes to learn how the alien mineral responds to Elune’s magic.

Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry. In Stranglethorn Vale, the master smith Galvan the Ancient works to fashion specialized armament capable of striking down powerful demons. This forging provides an enchanted weapon imbued with the Felcurse, designed specifically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his servitors. Galvan the Ancient requires patience while he works his craft just south of the path leading into Zul'Gurub. Rushing the forging risks creating a flawed blade, staff, or dagger. Once completed, the chosen weapon carries the power of the Felcurse, which can be unleashed periodically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic underlings. The duration of this debilitating curse can vary.

Enchanted Gaea Seeds. Enchanted Gaea Seeds are specially prepared botanical seeds meant to bring revitalization to the ravaged landscapes of Kalimdor. Empowered through druidic magic and gathered at Sun Rock Retreat, they are planted directly into the ash-choked soil of the Charred Vale to counteract devastation and rekindle natural growth. The Enchanted Gaea Seeds represent the Horde's druidic efforts to mend the deep scars left across Stonetalon Mountains. After raw Gaea Seeds are gathered and ritually enchanted by Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat, they carry sufficient resilience to overcome pervasive corruption and elemental blight. When pressed into the fertile dirt mounds that still survive beneath the soot of the Charred Vale, these seeds take root against the harsh conditions, anchoring new life in a landscape dominated by hostile fire elementals and invasive harpies.

Enchanted Resonite Crystal. The Enchanted Resonite Crystal is an alchemically altered mineral infused with shamanic magic by Mor'rogal in the Stonetalon Mountains. It is crafted specifically to shatter the Resonite cask binding a slumbering, ancient Earthen named Goggeroc. Raw resonite crystals gathered from the deep caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains possess unusual harmonic and earthen properties. Recognizing the danger slumbering within a sealed subterranean cask, the shaman Mor'rogal altered the raw minerals using his elemental powers. The resulting Enchanted Resonite Crystal serves as a precise tool: when struck against the reinforced Resonite cask, it disrupts the housing and forcibly rouses the giant Earthen Goggeroc while he is still disoriented from his long sleep.

Encroaching Gnolls. Encroaching Gnolls is an Alliance task that alerts the town guard of Lakeshire to gnolls prowling dangerously close to the Elwynn border. Guard Parker discovers encampments clustering along the border pass, sending travelers ahead to warn Deputy Feldon. The news confirms Lakeshire's growing fears that the beastmen are threatening to cut off Redridge entirely. The road linking Elwynn Forest to Redridge Mountains should be one of the most secure transit routes in the kingdom, but Stormwind's thinned forces leave it minimally defended. Guard Parker is stationed along the western border trail to monitor movement. While he manages to keep the gravel road passable for supply wagons, his scouting sweeps north and east reveal that gnoll warbands have advanced from the crags, establishing camps alarmingly near the road.

Encroaching Wildlife. Watcher Biggs was bound for the eastern coast with a caravan when the lost ones attacked. Biggs alone survived, and now wild creatures skulk near the camp. Biggs asks for your help defending it. This follows Help Watcher Biggs. The caravan of Watcher Biggs was bound for the eastern coast, but it never arrived. Lost Ones attacked, killing the guards and smashing the supplies, and Biggs alone survived. Biggs has sworn to protect what supplies remain, yet wild creatures skulk close to the camp. Biggs wants you to help defend it.

Encroachment. Encroachment is a Horde quest directed by Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in central Durotar. It charges champions with striking deep into the western bramble dens to eliminate the entrenched Razormane quilboar threatening the borders of the young orc nation. When Thrall led the orcs to Kalimdor and founded Durotar, they found much of the harsh, arid land already inhabited by the Razormane quilboar. These aggressive, boar-like creatures proved a constant thorn in the side of the new settlement. Through sustained military efforts, the Horde drove back the bulk of their numbers, yet fortified pockets of Razormane continue to cling stubbornly to their thorned redoubts west of Razor Hill.

Encrusted Tail Fins. Wizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway fears the rocket car is so fast that friction will tear it apart. To protect it, he needs tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats, and worries that friction will tear it apart. The moving parts need a coat of composite that is hard but not brittle, and able to resist salt corrosion, or the flats will eat the car away. Its key ingredient is the tail fins of the Saltscale murlocs, who live at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. You are asked to bring Wizzle ten of them.

Encrypted Letter. Among the Syndicate documents, one of the letters on a table is encrypted and inscrutable. Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore is the one to show it to. Among the Syndicate documents lies a table of letters, and one of them is encrypted and inscrutable. Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore is the one to show it to.

Encrypted Memorandum. The Encrypted Memorandum is a coded missive handed to novice rogues starting out in Coldridge Valley. Though disguised as official communication, it is actually a clandestine invitation from the local rogue trainer, Solm Hargrin, calling for solidarity among scoundrels in exile. In the bustling dwarven refuge of Anvilmar, rogues must maintain a low profile. Rather than approaching recruits in plain view, the trainer Solm Hargrin uses the Encrypted Memorandum to establish contact. Masked as an official directive from distant superiors, the coded parchment ensures that fledgling rogues know where to find mentorship without drawing unwanted attention from the local guards or suspicious townsfolk.

Encrypted Memorandum. The Encrypted Memorandum is an introductory summons directed at fledgling gnome rogues arriving in Coldridge Valley. Passed through Sten Stoutarm, the disguised note quietly directs new operatives to seek out Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar. While newcomer gnomes assist the mountaineers of Coldridge Valley with local trogg threats, Sten Stoutarm delivers a folded piece of parchment passed to him in confidence. Posing superficially as an official memorandum, the note is an invitation to meet Solm Hargrin, the resident rogue trainer stationed inside Anvilmar.

Encrypted Parchment. In the Valley of Trials, Encrypted Parchment guides young orc rogues toward the Den. Gornek hands it to recruits who show promise, and its cipher points them to Rwag, the hidden trainer. Young orcs prove their strength in the Valley of Trials under the open sun. Those who show a gift for stealth, deception, and bladecraft draw different notice. After facing the local wildlife, promising orc rogues receive Encrypted Parchment from Gornek. Its coded words call to those who can read a message meant to stay hidden.

Encrypted Parchment. In the Valley of Trials, Encrypted Parchment sends proven novice orc rogues into the Den. Its cipher points them to Rwag, an agent of the Shattered Hand. Gornek passes the coded parchment to novice orcs who have proved themselves against the local wildlife. Other trainers recruit pupils openly in the clearing, but rogue instructor Rwag sends his summons by cipher. The message directs you beyond the sunlit camp and deep into the cavern called the Den.

Encrypted Rune. An Encrypted Rune is a coded summoning message handed to promising new rogues in Coldridge Valley. Delivered covertly, it bids the bearer to decipher its contents and seek out the rogue trainer Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar. In the sheltered snowy basin of Coldridge Valley, overt recruitment is rarely the style of the local scoundrels and scouts. Instead, novitiates showing a knack for stealth and cunning are slipped an Encrypted Rune. Marked with subtle ciphers, the inscribed stone carries a discreet invitation from Solm Hargrin, the rogue mentor quartered in Anvilmar. It serves as both a private test of literacy in thieves' cant and an introduction to the shadowy craft needed to survive Dun Morogh's harsh wilderness.

Encrypted Rune. The Encrypted Rune is a coded missive delivered to aspiring rogues taking their first steps in Coldridge Valley. Passed along by Sten Stoutarm, the etched message directs promising shadows into Anvilmar to report to the rogue trainer, Solm Hargrin. While assisting Sten Stoutarm out in the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley, sharp-eyed rogues receive a curious etched stone. Sten admits the piece was slipped to him to hand over, suspecting it came directly from Solm Hargrin. Rather than shouting out across the courtyard for potential scouts and scoundrels, Solm uses an encrypted rune to test a novice's discretion and summon them indoors.

Encrypted Scroll. The Encrypted Scroll is a discreet parchment delivered to promising newly risen rogues in Deathknell. Bearing the seal of David Trias, it directs the recipient to introduce themselves for formal training among the Forsaken's covert operatives. When a freshly awakened Forsaken shows an aptitude for stealth and subterfuge, they do not remain unnoticed for long. The Encrypted Scroll is handed over in Deathknell once a scout proves capable against the mindless Scourge roaming the nearby graveyard. Bearing the personal seal of the rogue trainer David Trias, the scroll instructs the bearer to seek him out in the local inn. It serves as an initial vetting process, pointing fledgling operatives toward the discipline required to serve the Dark Lady rather than wasting their second chance at life as mere pickpockets.

Encrypted Scroll. The Encrypted Scroll is a discreet summons delivered to freshly awakened Forsaken rogues in Deathknell. Passed along by Shadow Priest Sarvis, the cipher directs the recruit to David Trias, a rogue mentor operating quietly out of the local inn. While newly raised Forsaken battle mindless zombies in the cemetery, the settlement's leadership takes note of those with particular inclinations toward stealth and subterfuge. Shadow Priest Sarvis passes this sealed parchment to promising scouts once their initial readiness is proven. Stamped with the discreet seal of David Trias, it serves as an early introduction to the shadowy network operating beneath the Forsaken hierarchy.

Encrypted Sigil. In Shadowglen, the Encrypted Sigil carries a summons to newly awakened night elf rogues. Frahun Shadewhisper calls them to begin training as dangers gather around Teldrassil. New night elf scouts and infiltrators in Shadowglen receive the Encrypted Sigil through discreet means. A quiet messenger delivers it on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper. Its contents are hidden instructions that tell the initiate to report to Frahun near Aldrassil. Reading and delivering the token shows Frahun that an initiate can follow subtle directions and handle covert messages.

Encrypted Sigil. In Shadowglen, a coded summons calls new night elf rogues to begin their training. Conservator Ilthalaine carries it for Frahun Shadewhisper, who also warns of the fragile peace across Kalimdor. While young night elves study nature's balance under Conservator Ilthalaine, those drawn to stealth receive a quieter summons. A runner brings the Encrypted Sigil from Frahun Shadewhisper, Shadowglen's rogue mentor. Its ciphers are meant for initiates of the trade. The bearer is to decipher the message and find Frahun near the roots of Aldrassil to begin instruction.

Encrypted Tablet. In the Valley of Trials, the Encrypted Tablet sends novice troll rogues to Rwag. The rogue trainer inscribes its coded message and keeps his post inside the Den. Novice troll rogues receive the Encrypted Tablet when they arrive in the Valley of Trials. Its ciphered words direct them to Rwag, an orc trainer who lives in the Den’s shaded caves. The slate keeps the local shadow operatives’ business discreet while testing whether new recruits can understand its message.

Encrypted Tablet. In the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives a coded summons to aspiring rogues. It sends them to Rwag in the Den, where rogue instruction meets the Shattered Hand. Gornek gives an Encrypted Tablet to each initiate who proves their mettle against the local wildlife. Its message is written in cipher, a fitting test and precaution for those trained in stealth, poison, and subterfuge. The summons directs the recruit into the Den to meet Rwag, who trains the Horde’s rogues, thieves, and cutpurses.

Engineering Labs. The Engineering Labs are a multi-tiered research and manufacturing facility deep within Gnomeregan. Connected to the Workshop Entrance and Launch Bay, this bustling center of gnome innovation was overrun during the city's radioactive cataclysm and is now swarming with crazed leper gnomes and rogue mechanical contraptions. Built around a central mechanical structure, the Engineering Labs span two primary tiers connected by a central cargo lift. In Gnomeregan's prime, tinkerers here developed schematics and fine-tuned clockwork inventions. Today, radiation leaks have driven the remaining researchers mad, transforming them into deranged leper gnomes who mindlessly guard malfunctioning machinery alongside rogue constructs.

Enraged Spirits. Enraged Spirits is an Alliance quest given by Kaela Shadowspear in the Stonetalon Mountains. After the Venture Company laid waste to the Charred Vale with fire and heavy machinery, furious fire elementals broke free and overran the blighted basin. Alliance champions are asked to quell these roaming spirits of flame and stone so the wounded land might one day heal under Elune's grace. The Charred Vale was once a lush haven within Stonetalon, but the reckless greed of the Venture Company transformed it into an ashen wasteland. In their drive to log and strip the land of resources, the goblins deployed incendiary devices and heavy machinery that set the entire canopy ablaze. Their destructive meddling did not merely destroy trees; it shattered the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth.

Enraged Thunder Lizards. In the southern Barrens, thunder lizards roam the plains around Camp Taurajo. Jorn Skyseer calls hunters to face the great beasts and bring back their blood as part of a wider rite of passage. After defeating the raptor Ishamuhale, you return to Camp Taurajo. The tauren elder Jorn Skyseer now tests your strength against the largest grazers of the land. Stormsnouts and Thunderheads roam the southern Barrens, their heavy strides able to crush an unwary hunter beneath them.

Enticing Negolash. Along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale rests an abandoned lifeboat marked with the faded words Smotts' Revenge. Piling barbecued buzzard wings and junglevine wine upon the wrecked craft serves to lure out the giant Negolash. The wreckage of a small boat lies neglected, carrying only weathered lettering that names it Smotts' Revenge. To catch the attention of Negolash during the hunt against him, the boat must be turned into bait, heaped with ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine.

Erion Shadewhisper. Jannok Breezesong sends promising rogues from Teldrassil to Darnassus. At the Cenarion Enclave, Erion Shadewhisper points them toward work beyond the forests. Jannok Breezesong sends you from Teldrassil to find Erion Shadewhisper in Darnassus. You need not worry about being sent to the exacting trainer Syurna. Erion waits in the Cenarion Enclave, where he handles work that calls for a quieter touch.

Erion's Behest. Across the Great Sea, Erion's Behest carries a summons to promising night elf rogues in Darnassus. Erion Shadewhisper sees their growing skill in stealth and sends them to Stormwind City to report to Stormwind Intelligence. Night elf rogues in Teldrassil's shadow train under mentors such as Erion Shadewhisper. When one shows exceptional talent, word reaches beyond the World Tree. Through Erion, Stormwind Intelligence, known as SI:7, invites the rogue across the Great Sea to the human capital.

Escape Through Force. In Darkshore, Volcor fights through the wild to reach safety. He reunites with Grimclaw by the road, and you carry word of his escape to Terenthis in Auberdine. Volcor is stranded in Darkshore's perilous wilderness, with danger closing around him. He chooses to fight through the hostile creatures rather than slip away unseen. His skill in battle clears a path straight to the main road and safety.

Escape Through Stealth. In Darkshore, Volcor needs help escaping a furbolg den. Guide the trapped night elf scout past hostile beasts, then report to Terenthis in Auberdine. Volcor, a night elf scout sent to investigate Darkshore's mounting threats, is trapped inside a furbolg cave. Cut off from the main roads and outnumbered, he needs an ally to help him escape before the furbolgs discover him.

Escaping Ban'ethil. Escaping Ban'ethil is a rescue mission within the subterranean barrow den on Teldrassil. Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom, captured by aggressive Gnarlpine furbolg while delivering a message to slumbering druids, must be escorted safely back to the surface and reported safe to Dolanaar. Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom was dispatched on an urgent errand by the Oracle Tree to convey a message to the druids resting within Ban'ethil Barrow Den. What was meant to be a routine courier duty turned disastrous when she discovered the subterranean chambers thoroughly overrun by aggressive Gnarlpine furbolg. Cut off and ambushed before she could retreat, she was taken prisoner in the dark tunnels, fearing a grim demise at the hands of the tribe until an adventurer intervened to fight her to the surface.

Escorting Erland. Trapped indoors by aggressive prowling predators, Deathstalker Erland requires an escort through Silverpine Forest to regroup with his partner. Assisting him safely across the wilderness delivers him directly to Deathstalker Rane Yorick. Even seasoned scouts of the Forsaken occasionally find themselves outmatched by the unforgiving ecology of Silverpine Forest. Deathstalker Erland finds himself cornered inside a dilapidated shelter, surrounded by starved wolves eager to pick at what little flesh remains on his withered frame. Alone, breaking through their pack is suicide.

Essence of Nightlash. The Essence of Nightlash is the lingering magical remnant collected from the defeated banshee Nightlash at the Dead Fields. It serves as irrefutable proof for High Executor Hadrec that the Scourge force bolstering the local rot hide gnolls has been broken. At an abandoned farmstead in northern Silverpine known as the Dead Fields, packs of undead rot hide gnolls have entrenched themselves under Scourge command. Initial Forsaken assaults were repeatedly broken not by the feral gnolls, but by their spectral commander: the banshee Nightlash. Calling upon wailing magics, she reinforced the gnoll lines and routed the forces sent from the Sepulcher. Slaying her dissolves her incorporeal form into dust, leaving behind a crystalline, magical essence that represents her permanent dissolution.

Essential Artificial. An Essential Artificial is a versatile, standardized mechanical component vital to gnomish tinkers and engineers. Left behind in stockpiles during the frantic evacuation of Gnomeregan, these parts are highly sought after by gnomes seeking to rebuild their technological efforts from exile in Ironforge. Before the fall of Gnomeregan, the essential artificial served as a cornerstone of day-to-day gnomish engineering. Described by tinkers as a nigh-universal component, it was integrated into countless contraptions, clockwork wonders, and heavy machinery throughout the subterranean halls. Its standardized nature made it indispensable to smiths and machinists seeking reliable, interchangeable modular parts.

Essential Artificials. Essential Artificials is an Alliance quest offered by Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Tasked with plumbing the depths of the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan, adventurers must recover crucial universal components that were abandoned during the gnomes' desperate evacuation. When the trogg invasion overwhelmed Gnomeregan and toxic radiation flooded its corridors, the fleeing gnomes could only carry what was immediately at hand. Among the countless marvels left behind were supplies of essential artificials—specialized, nigh-universal mechanical components prized by tinkers and crafters. Now operating out of Tinker Town in Ironforge, master tinker Klockmort Spannerspan finds his groundbreaking new experiments stalled without them.

Etched Note. The Etched Note is a formal summons delivered to promising young tauren hunters resting at Camp Narache. Penned by the camp's hunter trainer, Lanka Farshot, the message welcomes the novice into the traditions of the hunt and calls them forward for their initial instruction. Within the safe confines of Camp Narache, young shu'halo are recognized early for their natural inclinations and family lineages. The Etched Note is delivered by a runner on behalf of Lanka Farshot, the resident hunter mentor. It names the hunter as the heart of the tribe while serving as a stern reminder that raw instinct must be tempered through rigorous instruction and a deep reverence for the wilderness of Mulgore.

Etched Note. The Etched Note is a formal summons directed to promising young tauren hunters in Camp Narache. Delivered on behalf of the trainer Lanka Farshot, the message calls the novice forward to begin mastering the practical and spiritual arts of the wild. While training amidst the bluffs of Red Cloud Mesa, young tauren showing an aptitude for marksmanship and tracking are passed an etched message. Handed down through Grull Hawkwind, the note carries word that Lanka Farshot has taken notice of the youth's bloodline and raw capability, urging them to formalize their study beneath his watchful eye.

Etched Parchment. Gornek gives hunters in the Valley of Trials a summons from Jen'shan. The Etched Parchment points them toward their first lessons in Durotar. Young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin their rites in the Valley of Trials. As recruits prove themselves against the local vermin, Gornek guides them toward their calling. He gives the Etched Parchment to those who will wield bow, gun, and fang. Its message comes from Jen'shan, a skilled hunter trainer seeking fresh eyes and steady hands.

Etched Parchment. In the Valley of Trials, Etched Parchment calls a young hunter to Jen'shan. Gornek delivers it after the initiate's first blooding, opening the way to wilderness training in Durotar. After proving themselves against mottled boars, hunters in the Valley of Trials receive an etched parchment from Gornek. Jen'shan, a skilled Darkspear hunter, sent the note after watching new arrivals from the edges of the encampment. It welcomes the initiate to formal training and recognizes the instincts needed to master Durotar's untamed beasts and harsh land.

Etched Rune. The Etched Rune is a carved stone tablet given to aspiring dwarven hunters in Coldridge Valley. It serves as an invitation from the hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson, directing fledglings to seek him out within Anvilmar to begin their formal wilderness instruction. Carved with specific dwarven runes, this small stone tablet is passed along to novices who demonstrate potential out in the snowdrifts of Coldridge Valley. Sent by the mountaineer and hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson, the rune encourages fledgling trackers to pause their outdoor tasks and report to Anvilmar. Reading the stone marks a hunter's first step away from basic survival and toward understanding the deeper craft of the wild—learning to respect the beasts of Dun Morogh, track mountain predators, care for ranged weaponry, and endure the brutal elements.

Etched Rune. The Etched Rune is a written summons delivered to novice dwarven hunters assisting the guard in Coldridge Valley. Passed on by Sten Stoutarm, the inscribed stone directs fledgling trackers to seek out Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar to formally begin their martial and wilderness training. While helping Sten Stoutarm deal with nearby threats around Coldridge Valley, promising dwarven hunters are handed an inscribed stone tablet known as the Etched Rune. Rather than delivering spoken orders or simple parchment, dwarven mentors favor carved runes to impart formal missives. The rune instructs the recipient to take stock of their early work and present themselves indoors at Anvilmar for deeper instruction in the art of the hunt.

Etched Sigil. In Shadowglen, the Etched Sigil calls new night elf hunters to their trainer. Newly awakened night elf hunters receive the Etched Sigil as they enter Shadowglen. Its carved marks of the hunt carry a welcome and summons from Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer who lives high in Aldrassil’s hollowed boughs. The token sends each novice to seek her out and begin instruction in archery, wilderness tracking, and the night elf bond between stalker and beast.

Etched Sigil. In Shadowglen, the Etched Sigil calls young night elf hunters to Aldrassil. Through Conservator Ilthalaine, Ayanna Everstride summons them to meet their trainer and begin learning archery and beastcraft. After young kaldorei hunters help defend Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine gives them an inscribed token. A messenger brought it from their mentor, Ayanna Everstride. The sigil directs each novice up into Aldrassil’s high boughs, where the trainers watch over the canopy.

Etched Tablet. Gornek sends a carved tablet to hunters in the Valley of Trials. It bears Jen'shan's mark and calls them to begin training in the wilderness. Gornek brings novice hunters a carved tablet after they prove themselves against the boars near the Den. The stone bears Jen'shan's mark. She is a skilled troll huntswoman stationed nearby, and the message shows that seasoned hunters have noticed the young recruit's grit. The lesson now moves beyond surviving the local dangers and toward disciplined training in the wild.

Ethel Rethor. Ethel Rethor is an ancient night elven ruin situated along the rugged northwestern coast of Desolace. While a solitary, sealed tower still rises above the waves, the majority of the sunken settlement now lies submerged in the sea and overrun by hostile naga. Perched on the desolate coast of western Kalimdor, Ethel Rethor stands as a haunting reminder of the ancient night elven civilization that flourished before the Great Sundering. Much of the grand architecture has collapsed into the ocean depths, leaving only shattered foundations and a lone, weathered tower protruding from the surf. A small bridge extends toward the tower's sealed portal, but the structure remains shut tight against the elements and intruders alike. The submerged chambers and surrounding shallows have become a stronghold for coastal naga, making the waters treacherous for any who wander near.

Eva Sarkhoff. Eva Sarkhoff is the spectral remnant of the former head maid of House Barov, lingering alongside her husband Lucien just outside the horrors of Scholomance. Tortured and slain by the Butcher during the fall of Caer Darrow, her spirit seeks brave mortals to avenge their deaths and destroy their cursed remains. Eva served the wealthy Barov family for decades as their head maid, caring for the sprawling keep of Caer Darrow alongside her husband Lucien, the family butler. As the Barovs grew paranoid about their aging mortality and vast wealth, they struck a catastrophic pact with Kel'Thuzad. The manor was gradually handed over to the fledgling Cult of the Damned, warping the grand residence into Scholomance, a secretive academy of necromancy. Eva and Lucien hid in the keep's corridors for six months, scavenging food while watching cultists and monstrosities steadily take over their home.

Everlook. Everlook is a snow-swept trading outpost in central Winterspring established by the Steamwheedle Cartel. Situated at the crossroads of the snowy valley's routes, it serves as a neutral haven for merchants, prospectors, and researchers braving the high-altitude cold. Everlook represents the Steamwheedle Cartel's northernmost endeavor, mirroring outposts like Gadgetzan and Booty Bay under a blanket of permafrost. The walled settlement perches at the intersection of Winterspring's snowdrifts, operating under strictly enforced neutrality. It hosts the only operational bank and shared auction house services in the region, drawing both Alliance and Horde travelers in search of warmth and shelter. Guarded by hired bruisers, the town offers refuge from ferocious frostsabers and yetis.

Evershine. Evershine is an Alliance delivery quest beginning with Pilot Bellowfiz near Kharanos. The dwarven siege engine pilot sends travelers westward to Brewnall Village to fetch a potent dwarven brew concocted by Rejold Barleybrew. The liquor doubles as a warming drink and an emergency, high-octane fuel for Bellowfiz's siege engine. Dwarven brewing is famed throughout Khaz Modan, but Rejold Barleybrew's recipes in Brewnall Village push the boundaries of standard fermentation. His experimental beverage, Evershine, is infamous for knocking all but the sturdiest dwarves flat on their backs. Despite its fierce potency, it is prized in the bitter cold of Dun Morogh for its sheer heating power.
